10	/-!
11	# The algebra→scheme seam for two-chart ℙ¹ coboundaries
12	
13	The pure-algebra layer (`Picard/LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean` and the `Algebra/Laurent*`
14	files) characterises `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`, the coboundary subgroup of the abstract
15	two-chart datum `Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A` on the Laurent overlap ring
16	`LaurentPolynomial A`.  A scheme consumer of `Scheme.cechPic_eq_one_of_forall_presenting_coboundary`
17	instead holds `Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V`, the coboundary subgroup of the scheme
18	restriction maps `X.resHom` on `Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ`.
19	
20	Both are literally `TruncExpCech.cechCoboundaryUnits` of the respective restriction ring homs
21	(`Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits` unfolds to it by definition, `LaurentTwoChartCoboundary.lean`
22	and `TwoChartCechPicTrivial.lean:71`).  So an **identification of the two data** — ring
23	isomorphisms of the two chart section rings with `A[t]` and of the overlap section ring with
24	`A[T;T⁻¹]`, intertwining the scheme restrictions with `toLaurent`/`rightChart` — transports
25	coboundary membership between them.  This file is that seam: it consumes the identification as
26	hypotheses (the base-changed `ℙ¹_A` two-chart cover that realises them is the remaining scheme
27	build) and hands back the scheme-side `twoChartCoboundaryUnits` membership the criterion wants.
28	
29	Nothing here assumes the identifying isomorphisms are anything in particular, and nothing here
30	uses a new hypothesis on the ring `A`: it is the naturality of `cechCoboundaryUnits`
31	(`TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff`) instantiated at the two Laurent chart maps.
32	
33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent` — given the chart identification
36	  data, a scheme overlap unit is in `twoChartCoboundaryUnits V` iff its `A[T;T⁻¹]ˣ` image is in
37	  `laurentCoboundaryUnits A`.
38	-/
39	
40	set_option autoImplicit false
41	
42	universe u
43	
44	open CategoryTheory
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : Bool → X.Opens}
49	
50	/-- **The algebra→scheme coboundary seam.**
51	
52	Suppose the two-chart cover `V` of `X` is Laurent-identified over `A`: ring isomorphisms
53	`γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* A[t]`, `γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* A[t]` of the two chart section rings and
54	`γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* A[T;T⁻¹]` of the overlap section ring, intertwining the
55	scheme restrictions `X.resHom` with the two Laurent chart maps
56	(`Polynomial.toLaurent`, `rightChart A`):
57	
58	* `hres₀ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_left) = toLaurent ∘ γ₀`;
59	* `hres₁ : γ₀₁ ∘ resHom(inf_le_right) = rightChart A ∘ γ₁`.
60	
61	Then a scheme overlap unit `u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ` is a two-chart coboundary iff its
62	image `Units.map γ₀₁ u : (A[T;T⁻¹])ˣ` is a Laurent coboundary.  Composed with the landed
63	`mem_laurentCoboundaryUnits_iff_general`, this reads the scheme-side coboundary condition off
64	the exponent-zero normal form of the transported Laurent unit — with no new hypothesis. -/
65	theorem mem_twoChartCoboundaryUnits_iff_laurent
66	    (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) ≃+* Polynomial A) (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) ≃+* Polynomial A)
67	    (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial A)
68	    (hres₀ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
69	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
70	      = (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
71	        (γ₀ : Γ(X, V false) →+* Polynomial A))
72	    (hres₁ : (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).comp
73	        (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
74	      = (rightChart A).comp (γ₁ : Γ(X, V true) →+* Polynomial A))
75	    (u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
76	    u ∈ Scheme.twoChartCoboundaryUnits V
77	      ↔ Units.map (γ₀₁ : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true) →+* LaurentPolynomial A).toMonoidHom u
78	          ∈ laurentCoboundaryUnits A := by
79	  have h :=
80	    TruncExpCech.mem_cechCoboundaryUnits_map_iff
81	      (X.resHom (inf_le_left : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V false))
82	      (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true))
83	      (Polynomial.toLaurent : Polynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial A) (rightChart A)
84	      γ₀ γ₁ γ₀₁ hres₀ hres₁ u
85	  exact h.symm

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic
7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks

9	/-!
10	# The relative Picard functor of a curve
11	
12	For a scheme `C` over a field `k` (an object of `Over (Spec k)`) this file defines the
13	relative Picard functor of Grothendieck–Kleiman:
14	$$\operatorname{Pic}_{C/k}(T) \;=\; \operatorname{Pic}(C \times_k T)\,/\,
15	  \operatorname{Pic}(T),$$
16	line-bundle classes on `C ⊗ T` modulo classes pulled back from the test object `T`
17	along the second projection. The quotient — never the absolute `Pic(C ⊗ T)`, which is
18	not even a separated presheaf in any useful sense — is the functor that étale
19	sheafification and the representability theorem consume.
20	
21	Products are the cartesian-monoidal product of `Over (Spec k)` (chosen pullbacks of
22	schemes): `C ⊗ T`, projection `snd C T`, whiskering `C ◁ g`, matching the vocabulary
23	of the challenge statement file.
24	
25	## Main declarations
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picFromBase C T`: the subgroup of `(C ⊗ T).left.CechPic` of classes
28	  pulled back from `T` along the second projection.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPic C T`: the relative Picard group, the quotient by
30	  `picFromBase C T`, a `CommGroup`; `relPicMk` is the projection, with
31	  `relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff` the exact coset relation (a genuine range condition, no
32	  choice, no `Nonempty (≅)`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicMap C g`: restriction along `g : T' ⟶ T`, descended from
34	  pullback of Čech classes along `C ◁ g`.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicFunctor C`: the relative Picard functor
36	  `(Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false
40	
41	universe u
42	
43	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
44	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)
45	
46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
47	
48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
49	
50	noncomputable section
51	
52	/-- The subgroup of Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` pulled back from the test object `T`
53	along the second projection. The relative Picard group is the quotient by it. -/
54	def picFromBase (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup ((C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :=
55	  (CechPic.map (snd C T).left).range
56	
57	lemma mem_picFromBase_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
58	    L ∈ picFromBase C T ↔ ∃ N : T.left.CechPic, CechPic.map (snd C T).left N = L :=
59	  Iff.rfl
60	
61	/-- The relative Picard group of `C/k` at a test object `T`: Picard classes on `C ⊗ T`
62	modulo classes pulled back from `T`. -/
63	def relPic (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
64	  (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic ⧸ picFromBase C T
65	
66	noncomputable instance (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : CommGroup (relPic C T) :=
67	  QuotientGroup.Quotient.commGroup (picFromBase C T)
68	
69	/-- The projection from Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` to the relative Picard group. -/
70	noncomputable def relPicMk (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
71	    (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic →* relPic C T :=
72	  QuotientGroup.mk' (picFromBase C T)
73	
74	lemma relPicMk_surjective (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
75	    Function.Surjective (relPicMk C T) :=
76	  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (picFromBase C T)
77	
78	/-- The exact coset relation: two Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` have equal image in the
79	relative Picard group iff their ratio is pulled back from `T`. -/
80	lemma relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
81	    {L L' : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
82	    relPicMk C T L = relPicMk C T L' ↔ L / L' ∈ picFromBase C T :=
83	  QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem

87	    (mk : ∀ L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic, motive (relPicMk C T L)) (x : relPic C T) :
88	    motive x :=

94	from `T'`: the well-definedness of `relPicMap` on the `H_T`-cosets. -/
95	lemma picFromBase_le_comap (g : T' ⟶ T) :
96	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C T').comap (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) := by

99	  show CechPic.map (snd C T').left (CechPic.map g.left N)

101	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
102	    ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whiskerLeft_snd]

104	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along `g : T' ⟶ T`: pull back along
105	`C ◁ g` and descend to the quotients. -/

107	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C T')
108	    (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left) (picFromBase_le_comap C g)
109

112	    relPicMap C g (relPicMk C T L) = relPicMk C T' (CechPic.map (C ◁ g).left L) :=
113	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
114	
115	lemma relPicMap_id (x : relPic C T) : relPicMap C (𝟙 T) x = x := by
116	  induction x using relPic.ind with
117	  | mk L =>
118	    rw [relPicMap_mk, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Over.id_left,
119	      Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
120	    rfl

123	    relPicMap C (h ≫ g) x = relPicMap C h (relPicMap C g x) := by
124	  induction x using relPic.ind with
125	  | mk L =>
126	    rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk, relPicMap_mk]
127	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C T'') ?_
128	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
129	      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
130	
131	/-- The relative Picard functor `T ↦ Pic(C ⊗ T)/Pic(T)` of Grothendieck–Kleiman, as a
132	presheaf of commutative groups on `Over (Spec k)`. -/
133	noncomputable def relPicFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} where
134	  obj T := CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop)
135	  map g := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMap C g.unop)
136	  map_id T := by
137	    ext x
138	    exact relPicMap_id C x
139	  map_comp g h := by
140	    ext x
141	    exact relPicMap_comp C g.unop h.unop x
142	
143	@[simp]
144	lemma relPicFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
145	    (relPicFunctor C).obj T = CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop) :=
146	  rfl
147

13	
14	For the challenge curve `C` over a field `k`, a commutative `k`-algebra `R` (the **affine
15	test ring**), and an affine two-chart cover `D` of `C.left`, this file assembles the

17	the relative curve `C_R := (C ⊗ Spec R).left` over `Spec R`, its base-changed affine
18	two-cover, and the degree-one cohomology of the structure sheaf as an explicit two-cover
19	cokernel over `R` — the general-coefficients carrier `Scheme.twoCoverH1LinearEquiv`
20	instantiated relatively at `k := R`.

22	## Main declarations

25	  over `Spec R` via the second projection (`relCurve.instOver`).
